scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large building complex with a grassy area and sidewalk in front of it. The buildings have a mix of modern and older styles, with some having balconies and others featuring large windows. A streetlight stands along the sidewalk, and there are several cars parked along the street. The sky is overcast.
